response.rationale: Both answers are valid. Indonesian adonan is broader than English dough but is the ordinary cooking term for dough; Malaysian doh specifically denotes kneaded flour-and-liquid dough. The different-common-word relation is accurate. Adunan is an overlapping broader Malay term, not a true false friend, so no material learner error is present.
